# The German Project

> A comprehensive German language learning platform offering free lessons, interactive grammar instruction, and native speaker audio content for beginners.

The German Project provides structured German language education through lessons hosted by Jens, covering foundational grammar, pronunciation, vocabulary, and conversational skills. The site also features German children's stories with bilingual read-alongs and comparative reviews of popular German learning courses.

## Key Topics

- German language learning
- Audio lessons
- Grammar basics
- Beginner lessons
- Pronunciation
- Verb conjugation
- German cases (nominative, accusative, dative)
- Vocabulary
- Children's stories
- Jens (instructor)
- Conversational German
- Denglisch
- German slang
- Language learning courses
- Native speaker audio

## Core Learning Hubs

- [Free online German lessons with audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons): Main German lessons hub with grammar, vocabulary, and audio featuring Jens
- [German Children's Stories with Slow Audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/stories): German children's stories with native speaker audio and bilingual read-along

## Beginner Grammar & Foundations

- [Learn German: Introduction to German](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/introduction): Beginner lesson introducing Jens, personal pronouns, formal vs informal speech
- [German sounds, symbols and pronunciation](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/german-pronunciation): Pronunciation guide for German sounds and special characters with audio
- [Introduction to German nouns](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/nouns): Grammar lesson on German nouns, genders, plurals, and articles
- [Introduction to German verbs](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/introduction-to-verbs): Beginner lesson on German verb conjugation patterns and haben verb
- [Learn how to say German numbers](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/numbers): Lesson on counting and German numbers from zero to billion
- [Greetings and essentials + audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/greetings-and-essentials): Essential German phrases: hello, please, thanks with audio pronunciation

## Advanced Grammar & Cases

- [German Nominative and Accusative cases + audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/nominative-accusative): Grammar lesson explaining German nominative and accusative cases
- [Learn German - Meet the "Lazy Dative" case](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/dative-case): Grammar lesson on German dative case with audio explanation
- [How to compare things in German + audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/comparing): Grammar lesson on German comparatives and superlatives with audio

## Conversational German

- [How to talk about yourself + audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/introducing-yourself): Conversational lesson on German smalltalk and personal introductions
- [How to ask questions in German + audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/questions): Lesson on German question formation with interrogative words and audio
- [Polite and informal commands + audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/commands): Grammar lesson on polite and informal command forms in German
- [Learn German - How to order in a restaurant + audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/restaurant): Conversational lesson on ordering food in German restaurants

## Vocabulary & Language Nuances

- [German / English cognates and Denglisch](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/cognates-denglisch): Lesson on English-German word similarities and false friends with audio
- [German slang phrases and expressions](https://www.thegermanproject.com/german-lessons/slang): Lesson on colloquial German slang and natural speech expressions

## Course Reviews & Comparisons

- [Our 5 Favorite Online German Courses in 2024](https://www.thegermanproject.com/review): Comparison reviews of top German courses including Rocket German and Wunderbla
- [Rocket German Review - Does it work?](https://www.thegermanproject.com/review/rocket-german-review): Detailed product review of Rocket German course strengths and weaknesses

## Optional

- [Henry Hühnchen: Chicken Little in German + Audio](https://www.thegermanproject.com/stories/chicken-little): Chicken Little fable in German and English with native speaker audio
